VBEM.description: Virtual Beam (VBEM). Each key is a virtual beam id whose two virtual section ids (VSEC1 at end i, VSEC2 at end j) define the beam's cross-sections.

VSEC1.description: Virtual section id at end i (start) of the virtual beam.

VSEC2.description: Virtual section id at end j (end) of the virtual beam.
